description: This file defines the interface IReminderService within the Orleans framework, specifying methods for managing grain reminders such as starting, stopping, registering, unregistering, and retrieving reminders.

classes.name: IReminderService
classes.description: An interface for managing reminders associated with grains, extending IGrainService and providing asynchronous methods for operations like start, stop, register, unregister, and retrieve reminders.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder or updates an existing one for a given grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder registered to a grain by name.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders registered for a specific grain.
